description: This file contains the implementation of the MockZigbeeCore class, which simulates a Zigbee network core for testing or development purposes. It provides methods to start and stop the core, manage devices, change network configurations, and send various events related to Zigbee network status.

classes.name: MockZigbeeCore
classes.description: A class that simulates Zigbee network core behavior for testing and development, providing control over device management, network configuration, and event simulation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MockZigbeeCore.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the EUI64 identifier of this Zigbee core instance.

methods.name: getOriginalEui64
methods.description: Returns the original EUI64 identifier.

methods.name: networkChange
methods.description: Changes the network configuration such as channel, PAN ID, and network key.

methods.name: getNetworkStatus
methods.description: Returns a table representing the current network status.

methods.name: setStatusListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for Zigbee status changes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the mock Zigbee core simulation.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists all devices connected or known to the core.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the mock Zigbee core simulation.

methods.name: sendStartupIfNecessary
methods.description: Sends a startup event if it has not been sent already.

methods.name: sendNetworkHealthProblem
methods.description: Simulates network health problem event.

methods.name: sendPanIdAttack
methods.description: Simulates a PAN ID attack event.

methods.name: sendNetworkHealthProblemRestored
methods.description: Simulates network health restoration event.

methods.name: getDevicesByType
methods.description: Retrieves devices filtered by specific class type.

methods.name: getDeviceByNameAndType
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its name and type.

methods.name: addDevice
methods.description: Adds a new device to the network.

methods.name: addPairedDevice
methods.description: Adds a device as a paired device.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Removes a device from the network.

methods.name: pairDevice
methods.description: Pairs a device internally.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if a device is paired.

methods.name: enableJoin
methods.description: Enables device joining for a specified duration.

methods.name: isNetworkOpenForJoin
methods.description: Checks if the network is open for device joining.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a device by EUI64.

methods.name: getAllDevices
methods.description: Returns all devices known to the core.

methods.name: getPairedDevices
methods.description: Returns all paired devices.

methods.name: getUnpairedDevices
methods.description: Returns all unpaired devices.

methods.name: getRefreshOtaFilesEventWaitHelper
methods.description: Provides the EventWaitHelper for OTA file refresh events.

methods.name: refreshOtaFiles
methods.description: Triggers OTA files refresh event.

methods.name: networkHealthCheckConfigure
methods.description: Configures network health check parameters (stub implementation).
